steps.note: Start the buyer-side event creation flow.
Ensure the Withdraw option is available as required by the case configuration.
Provide the mandatory event title so the event can be published.
Create an RFQ stage, which is the stage used for Order Activity.
Apply the first available RFQ template.
Add the required line item for a publishable event.
Commit a valid event schedule before publishing.
Add a QA vendor so the event is usable.
Publish the test event whose activity will be checked.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Withdraw the project with a remark so the withdrawal is recorded.
Confirm Procol records the project as withdrawn.
Open the RFQ stage's Order Activity drawer.
Confirm the Order Activity drawer is open.
Verify the activity history contains the withdrawal entry.
Verify an earlier event-creation activity remains visible.
Check that the creation activity appears before the withdrawal activity.
